Despite Sony and Nintendo's war on PC, Console exclusives are finally coming to Battle Stations near you - thanks to major advancements in... AI-assisted decompilation, PS5 and PS4 emulation, and binary relinking... once locked-away games are running natively on PC hardware. We explore how these breakthroughs work, test performance, and discuss what this means for the future of gaming.
